verdict.rationale: Framer's documented AI features are generative and action-oriented. The agent creates pages, copy and visuals, restyles the site, and sets up or updates the CMS. Nothing shows the product analyzing the user's own data (analytics, CMS content, site performance) to produce insights or suggestions. The 'conversion best practices' item is a user-written prompt instructing the agent, not an AI-generated insight from the user's data, and the AEO 'scan' mention is too vague to count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
